ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 / Midnight Blizzard service principal credential addition followed by app-only Exchange Online access
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Midnight Blizzard / Nobelium post-compromise tradecraft used against Microsoft Corp (Jan 2024), HPE, SolarWinds downstream tenants, and other M365 victims: an operator adds a fresh secret or certificate to an existing OAuth application / service principal (or consents to one with Mail.Read app permission), then signs in as that service principal to Exchange Online from infrastructure distinct from the cred-add infra to silently exfil mail. Chains T1098.001 (Add Cloud Credentials) → T1550.001 (Application Access Token) → T1114.002 (Remote Email Collection) — a TTP combinatio
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as credAddTime values(Authentication.src) as adminSrc values(Authentication.user) as adminUser values(Authentication.signature) as credAddSig from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" (Authentication.signature="Add service principal credentials." OR Authentication.signature="Update application*Certificates*" OR Authentication.signature="Consent to application.") by Authentication.app
| rename Authentication.app as app
| join type=inner app [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as spSignInTime values(Authentication.src) as spSrc values(Authentication.dest) as spDest values(Authentication.user) as spName from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.user_type="ServicePrincipal" Authentication.action="success" (Authentication.dest="Office 365 Exchange Online" OR Authentication.dest="Microsoft Graph" OR Authentication.dest="Office 365 Management APIs") by Authentication.app
  ]
| where spSignInTime >= credAddTime AND spSignInTime <= credAddTime+604800 AND adminSrc!=spSrc
| eval minutesToFirstAccess=round((spSignInTime-credAddTime)/60,1)
| table credAddTime spSignInTime minutesToFirstAccess app adminUser adminSrc spName spSrc spDest credAddSig
| sort - credAddTime
ucs.kql:
let CredAdds = CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in~ ("Add service principal credentials.","Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management","Update application","Consent to application.")
| extend TargetAppId = tostring(parse_json(tostring(RawEventData.Target))[0].ID),
         ActorUpn = AccountDisplayName,
         ActorIp = IPAddress
| where isnotempty(TargetAppId)
| project CredAddTime = Timestamp, ActorUpn, ActorIp, ActorCountry = CountryCode, ActorUa = UserAgent, TargetAppId;
let AppOnlyMailAccess = CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where Application has_any ("Office 365","Exchange Online")
| where ActionType in~ ("MailItemsAccessed","Send","SendAs","MessageBind","Create","Update")
| extend CallerAppId = tostring(RawEventData.AppId)
| where isnotempty(CallerAppId)
| project MailTime = Timestamp, CallerAppId, MailIp = IPAddress, MailCountry = CountryCode, MailUa = UserAgent, Mailbox = ObjectName;
CredAdds
| join kind=inner AppOnlyMailAccess on $left.TargetAppId == $right.CallerAppId
| where MailTime between (CredAddTime .. CredAddTime + 7d)
| where ActorIp != MailIp                                  // cred-add infra != mailbox access infra is a strong APT29 fingerprint
| extend MinutesToAccess = datetime_diff('minute', MailTime, CredAddTime)
| project CredAddTime, MailTime, MinutesToAccess, ActorUpn, ActorIp, ActorCountry, TargetAppId, Mailbox, MailIp, MailCountry, MailUa
| order by CredAddTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CredAdds = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where OperationName in~ ("Add service principal credentials.","Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management","Update application","Consent to application","Add delegated permission grant")
| where Result == "success"
| extend ActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         ActorIp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend TargetAppId  = tostring(TargetResources.id),
         TargetAppName = tostring(TargetResources.displayName),
         TargetType    = tostring(TargetResources.type)
| where TargetType in~ ("ServicePrincipal","Application")
| project CredAddTime = TimeGenerated, ActorUpn, ActorIp, TargetAppId, TargetAppName;
let SpSignIns = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ResourceDisplayName has_any ("Office 365 Exchange Online","Microsoft Graph","Office 365 Management APIs")
| where ResultType == 0
| project SpSignInTime = TimeGenerated, AppId, ServicePrincipalName, SpIp = IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName;
CredAdds
| join kind=inner SpSignIns on $left.TargetAppId == $right.AppId
| where SpSignInTime between (CredAddTime .. CredAddTime + 7d)
| where ActorIp != SpIp                                    // cred-add infra != SP sign-in infra is a strong APT29 fingerprint
| extend MinutesToFirstAccess = datetime_diff('minute', SpSignInTime, CredAddTime)
| project CredAddTime, SpSignInTime, MinutesToFirstAccess,
          ActorUpn, ActorIp, TargetAppId, TargetAppName,
          ServicePrincipalName, SpIp, ResourceDisplayName
| order by CredAddTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Add service principal credentials." OR "Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management" OR "Consent to application." OR "Add delegated permission grant") AND (@properties.targetResources.type:ServicePrincipal OR @properties.targetResources.type:Application)
ucs.rationale: This is the documented Midnight Blizzard / SVR access-extension pattern from the Jan-2024 Microsoft corporate mailbox breach and the Hewlett Packard Enterprise 2023 intrusion: rather than burn an interactive user session, APT29 leverages a legitimate first-party or third-party OAuth application, mints a new client secret, and authenticates app-only against Exchange Online to read mail with no MFA

ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 / Midnight Blizzard residential-proxy password spray landing on legacy-auth account
ucs.description: Catches the initial-access vector publicly attributed to Midnight Blizzard against Microsoft Corp, EU foreign-ministry tenants, and the TeamCity-targeting wave: low-and-slow password spray distributed across residential proxy / TOR / anonymizer infrastructure (T1090.003) against many M365 UPNs, deliberately landing on a legacy / non-prod / service account that lacks MFA and supports legacy auth (EWS, IMAP, SMTP AUTH). Detects the spray pattern (single source IP touching many distinct UPNs in a short window) AND the eventual success on a legacy-protocol app — the specific chain that gave SVR a
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t 
    dc(Authentication.user) as UniqueUsersAttempted
    count(eval(Authentication.action="failure")) as Failures
    count(eval(Authentication.action="success")) as Successes
    values(eval(if(Authentication.action="success",Authentication.user,null))) as SuccessfulUsers
    values(Authentication.app) as Protocols
    values(Authentication.signature_id) as ErrorCodes
    values(Authentication.user_agent) as UserAgents
    min(_time) as FirstSeen
    max(_time) as LastSeen
    from datamodel=Authentication 
    where (Authentication.app IN ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP4","POP3","Authenticated SMTP","Other clients","Older Office clients","Exchange Online PowerShell") 
           OR Authentication.tag IN ("anonymizer","tor","residential_proxy")) 
    by Authentication.src _time span=4h
| where UniqueUsersAttempted >= 10 AND Successes >= 1
| rename Authentication.src as src_ip
| eval SprayRatio=round(Failures/UniqueUsersAttempted,2)
| sort - FirstSeen
| table FirstSeen LastSeen src_ip UniqueUsersAttempted Failures Successes SuccessfulUsers Protocols ErrorCodes UserAgents SprayRatio
ucs.kql:
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where IsAnonymousProxy == true 
     or ClientAppUsed in~ ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP4","POP3","Authenticated SMTP","Other clients","Older Office clients","Exchange Online PowerShell")
     or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium","high")
| extend IsFailure = ErrorCode != 0
| summarize 
    UniqueUsersAttempted = dcount(AccountUpn),
    SuccessfulUsers      = make_set_if(AccountUpn, ErrorCode == 0, 25),
    FailedUsers          = make_set_if(AccountUpn, IsFailure, 25),
    ErrorCodes           = make_set_if(ErrorCode, IsFailure, 10),     // 50053 lockout, 50126 wrong pw, 50055 expired pw
    LegacyProtocols      = make_set(ClientAppUsed, 10),
    Countries            = make_set(Country, 10),
    UserAgents           = make_set(UserAgent, 10),
    AnonProxyFlag        = max(toint(IsAnonymousProxy)),
    FirstSeen            = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen             = max(Timestamp)
    by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 4h)
| where UniqueUsersAttempted >= 10                    // 10 = empirical spray-vs-bruteforce threshold (P95 benign mass-failure source ~6)
| where array_length(SuccessfulUsers) >= 1            // spray that landed — the actionable signal
| extend SprayDensity = UniqueUsersAttempted          // operators: tune higher for very large tenants
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| extend RiskTypes   = tostring(RiskEventTypes),
         CountryCode = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| where RiskTypes has_any ("anonymizedIPAddress","passwordSpray","tor","unlikelyTravel","unfamiliarFeatures")
     or ClientAppUsed in~ ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP4","POP3","Authenticated SMTP","Other clients","Older Office clients","Exchange Online PowerShell")
| extend IsFailure = ResultType != "0"
| summarize 
    UniqueUsersAttempted = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    SuccessfulUsers      = make_set_if(UserPrincipalName, ResultType == "0", 25),
    FailedUsers          = make_set_if(UserPrincipalName, IsFailure, 25),
    ErrorCodes           = make_set_if(ResultType, IsFailure, 10),
    LegacyProtocols      = make_set(ClientAppUsed, 10),
    Countries            = make_set(CountryCode, 10),
    UserAgents           = make_set(UserAgent, 10),
    RiskFlags            = make_set(RiskTypes, 10),
    FirstSeen            = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen             = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 4h)
| where UniqueUsersAttempted >= 10                    // 10 = empirical spray-vs-bruteforce threshold
| where array_length(SuccessfulUsers) >= 1            // spray that landed
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:"Sign-in activity" (@properties.riskEventTypes:(anonymizedIPAddress OR passwordSpray OR tor) OR @properties.clientAppUsed:("Exchange ActiveSync" OR IMAP4 OR POP3 OR "Authenticated SMTP" OR "Other clients" OR "Older Office clients" OR "Exchange Online PowerShell"))
ucs.rationale: Midnight Blizzard's MSTIC-published TTP combination is the discriminator here: SVR doesn't run noisy 1000-IP credential-stuffing — they distribute attempts across residential-proxy / TOR pools (T1090.003) at low velocity AND deliberately target legacy authentication endpoints (EWS / IMAP / SMTP AUTH) where MFA cannot be enforced, then pivot through whichever low-value account they happen to land o
